items.title: Jiangsu Xinde Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. (07672)
items.en_title: Jiangsu Xinde Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. (07672)
items.en_oneliner: Semiconductor packaging and testing firm Xinde listed on 10 November at an offer range of HK$8.60-9.60. It closed its first day up 28.38%, after rising 13.29% in the grey market.

items.title: Suzhou Denglin Technology Co., Ltd. (09917)
items.en_oneliner: Semiconductor firm Denglin listed on 10 November at an offer range of HK$231.00-288.00, the highest pricing among this batch of listings. It closed its first day down 7.79%, after falling 4.24% in the grey market.
